steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Ederson, uh, sorry, I got to the cafeteria late an' there wasn't much left on the breakfast menu. These are all I got.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: It's okay, Mina. Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Oh, did you hand my resume in? What did they say, the Engineering? Gonna be coworkers real soon, right, you and I?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: What? I don't get why you're giving me that look...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Di... Did I get rejected?

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Mina, you were supposed to tell 'em we're from the same town! I came here just to crash with you! My background's spotless! I'm not some shady nobody!

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: I grew up around work sites! I practically lived with the site workers! I lay bricks, I stand beams, I take measurements, I rig scaffolding... I do it all! Hell, Rhodes could try me for a while, for free...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Ederson. We'll head back in two days. To Columbia.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: We?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: *hic*... They cut me too.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: So... Pinecone's gotta leave.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: When?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: ASAP, really.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Just like that?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Just like that.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: *sniff*...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: B-But... why would they wanna fire you?

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: You said in all your letters, right? Your dad always showed 'em to us! All like, you'd never dreamed you could work at a place like Rhodes Island, right? Good benefits, good pay, a place where people are people...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Yes, but Rhodes Island is still a company.

spans.text: Yes, but Rhodes Island is still a

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Sometimes it needs workers, sometimes it doesn't. We know how it works. It's the same story all over Columbia.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: (Wiping tears) C'mon, Ederson. You eat breakfast, I'm goin' to work. Bridge overhaul's down to the wire. Engineering could use my hands today.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Mina, doesn't it make you mad? You don't have to take this from them...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Not like Rhodes treated me badly while I was here.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: And besides, it's my job. I'm gonna finish it.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I need to find Kafka and straighten things out anyhow...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Kafka!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hey, Mina!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Sheesh, talk about puffy eyes. You sleeping bad? Hey, c'mon, cheer up... Oh, uh, I gotta see Aciddrop about a thing, I'll catch ya on the flippy.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: You—you...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Whassamatter?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: You don't got stuff you wanna say to me?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh, later I will, alright, Mina? Just gimme a li'l bit...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Just wanted to say you don't gotta worry about—

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Mina, you gonna stand there all day?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Coming.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: You've got your nailgun and nothing else on you? You leave your toolbag in the dorms again?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Uh, sorry, I...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I got distracted when I left.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: This is far from the first time, you know.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Just last week you left your spare batteries on site in the training grounds, and only remembered right before the grounds were closing down. The whole ship watched you run back panting and wheezing...

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: If it's not this, it's that. If it's not that, it's something else. We remember it all!

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: (So that's why...)

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: (You dummy, Mina. Nobody likes a klutz...)

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Alright, just use my toolbag for now.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Lemme double-check the assignment logs. You're handling the left side, I'm handling the right, and we need to finish servicing the whole bridge by today.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Why the rush?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: After this, we've gotta run maintenance on the middle decks, the lower decks, and critical areas like the ship's Catastrophe warning system and mining modules. We're doing as much prep as we can before we break the whole ship up.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: B—Break the whole ship up?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: We're just taking the whole landship and...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I was wondering why everyone seemed so busy lately...

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: When I was young, Dad told me, Mina, every day Columbia gives birth to countless new companies and construction teams, but the number of 'em hasn't changed much...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I didn't know what he meant at the time, but when I grew up and started roving from one work team to another, I started to understand.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: The land's ruthless. Companies are just as fragile as people.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: I can't say I know where this is coming from... Eh, well, it's beyond me. Engineering only got the order not long ago, so let's just knuckle down and finish this last job, Pinecone.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Oh, and once you clock out today, remember to go through the logs at Engineering.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: No wonder there's layoffs... And Rhodes Island was such a nice place...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Come on, Mina. Not like you can do anything about it...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Hi. The bridge is all serviced. I'm here to check the assignment logs for this period.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Oh, Pinecone. Could you wait a sec? Just give us a moment to finish up on this task.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: ...Sure.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Is that all of them?

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Notices of Approval from the Columbian Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium; the registration for our collaboration with Rhine Lab in the pharmaceutical industry; and registrations for other partnerships in the energy sector...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: The thickest file here is on Rim Billiton... Rhodes has dozens of high-risk mining operations in Billy under its belt thanks to us at Engineering and some individually named operators.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: The Victorian stuff is over there... Leithanien... Kazimierz...

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: You know, Engineering's literally never been busier. Are we really meant to just sit here sifting through old documents instead of helping the others out with the ship?

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: This is important work too, friend.

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: If you say so...

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: Once the ship's dismantled, our branch offices are gonna get a whole lot busier.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: These documents aren't just souvenirs from where we've been and what we've done.

steps.name: Engineering Operator B
steps.text: They can prove to others, and to ourselves, what we can do.

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: Oh, Pinecone, I signed off on your assignment logs for you.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Could I... could I, uh, ask you a favor?

steps.name: Engineering Operator C
steps.text: What do you need?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I'd like to obtain every assignment log of mine since I began employment here.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Mina! You're back. Finally.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Mm-hmm.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: You hash things out with 'em?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Ederson, there's been a wrench in the works. I—I don't really know best how to explain...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Well, what's happening to you? What happens with us?

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Mina, you're one of the strongest people I've ever known. Always have been.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: You made it through your dad's accident, you made it through your family's whole thing. I heard you even helped out the Simons' boy at Mansfield State Prison...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: You had to flee the country, you had to come all the way out here, and you still found a great job. But in the end, you're just gonna... go on back to Columbia?

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: The Pioneer project pushed our town out even further away from the nomadic cities. It's a dead-end back there, I'm telling you. Plus the whole business with Mr. Simon and your dad...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: And our old foremen and our old bosses. And whatever else might trip us up.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: ...I know. I know.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: And that's it? You're just gonna go from one site to the next, begging your way through life one employer at a time?

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Are you even listening to me, Mina?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: And what is that? You've been flipping through it ever since you got back...

spans.text: that? You've been flipping through it ever since you got back...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: All my work logs since I started employment here.
1,372 assignment logs.
Accident rate: 0.7%.
Work completed above spec: 42%.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Three years, nine months...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Didn't realize it'd been so long already...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Didn't realize I'd done so much...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Ederson, that's not gonna happen.

steps.name: Ederson
steps.text: Whatcha mean, Mina?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Maybe I'll take you back to Columbia, maybe Columbia's still the same as when I left, but... I'm not gonna let any of what you worried about happen.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: But first of all, I need to see someone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hey! Mina! I was just gonna head to your dorm!

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: *huff* Kafka, I was looking for you.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: Hear me out.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: Kafka, I know you're worried for me. I dunno how I should put this. / Mina, this is kind of awkward for me. I dunno where to even start.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: I know the truth already. The company's laying us off. I've seen it plenty of times myself. / I had no idea skateboarding was THIS MUCH fun until Aciddrop taught me how to kick it.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: Back when the big guy referred me here, all I wanted was a stable job. / I mean, kids who grew up on the streets NEED skateboards just like cops need crossbows and white-collar dumbasses need coffee.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: At first I could only handle assistant stuff, helping the Engineering crew while they did the big things... / So Aciddrop says the biggest skateboarding series is kicking off in two days, and Terra's best, ALL of Terra's best, are headin' there to grind wheels and make history.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: Rhodes has been a swell company, and a swell home. It's changed me in a lot of ways. / And you mark my words, for a newbie boarder like Kafka, this series'll be LIFE-CHANGING.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: It's been over three years, and I still forget my toolbag when I head out... / But see, that's the thing, I know you and I have an urgent Engineering assignment.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: But my job title kept on evolving anyway. In fact, I've led a number of projects and teams along the way. / It's important, we've gotta get to the Rhodes branch in Columbia as soon as we can...

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: Kafka, you oughta look at me and see a grown adult, a grown worker! / We've gotta set up a local taskforce for Rhodes so if the future throws hands, we can catch 'em.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: I'm an adult who's not scared of leaving home, I'm a worker who's not scared of making a living in the barrens. / I've been tyin' myself into clown balloons the whole day about this, Mina, but I figure I'm gonna hafta ask ya to go on ahead while I, uh, yeah.

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: I've made up my mind, I'm heading back to Columbia, I'm setting up my own work team! / But I'm gonna catch up with ya in a week at most!

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: And if the right moment comes, maybe I can come back and help Rhodes Island through a sticky spot! / So just for the next coupla days, you're representin' the Rhodes Island Engineering Department solo!

steps.name: Pinecone / Kafka
steps.text: I know I can do this! / I know you can do this!

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Rhodes branch... Work team... Bwuh?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hold up, Mina, I think you might be on a different page than me?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: This morning in the middle deck corridor, I heard you an' my colleague from Engineering talking...

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: So I mentioned before, Rhodes Island is set to kick work on the local branch offices into high gear. You two are from Columbia, and you know your way around the whole Pioneer craze. Effectively, this is a long-term field mission...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Roger dodger.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: So, you've gotta leave, Pinecone's gotta leave.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: When?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: ASAP, really.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Just like that?

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Just like that.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Look, I know about the skateboarding league thing—I'm a bit of a paragliding fan myself—and while I do wholly believe Pinecone could handle the early stages by herself...

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: How about this. You and Aciddrop skate off, and if you can win three points against her, I'll consider it essential that you participate in the upcoming series.

steps.name: Engineering Operator A
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Also, I hafta be the one to convince Pinecone.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: So, did you take three points from her?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I—took—FOUR!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Jeez, I am SO sorry about this humongous misunderstanding, Mina, I musta been putting you through hell...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: It—it's alright. Didn't go through nothin'...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Maybe I'm just not much of a thinker, I s'pose. Goin' on four years at Rhodes Island, and I never really stop to ask myself how I'm doing, except when I write letters to Dad...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Got my hard hat, my nailgun, my toolbag, my nice soft pillow... I go to work, I eat, I sleep, I get my pay, sometimes I go up on the deck an' sing with everyone... I'd think my life never changes.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: But really, truth is... I changed long ago. Well, in a good way, a really good one.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yannow, all this time I've known ya, and this might be the first time I've ever heard ya say so much in one breath...

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Uhm. I—Is it?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Mmm... nah, don't matter.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: Kafka. I dunno how exactly we got to this point today, but I think, uh... it works out the same anyway?

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: I'm gonna take Ederson back to Columbia and register at the branch office. Then I wanna visit my hometown again for a bit, and see Dad... Maybe there's some people we could really need there.

steps.name: Pinecone
steps.text: You can go report to the Engineering now. You convinced me.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: ...I think you're the one convincin' me, Mina.
